name: Cody Torgerson
occupation: Converse County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Cody Torgerson is a Converse County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Jim Willox, who is serving through the current term. The Douglas Budget / WyoRoundup reported that Trent Kaufman, Macey Moore, and Cody Torgerson will fill the three open commission seats.

sources.name: Douglas Budget / WyoRoundup, Nov. 3, 2026, Converse County voters pick new leaders in Douglas, Glenrock and Rolling Hills
